text:
The Incomer - Official Trailer (2026) Domhnall Gleeson, Gayle Rankin
Sundance Award-winning comedy, The Incomer is a modern folk fairy tale set on a remote Scottish island, where two siblings survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded Incomers'. Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland on behalf of the government.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Filipinana - Official Trailer (2026)
Isabel, a 17-year-old from the rural north of the Philippines, works at a posh country club outside Manila. Amid stifling heat and pervasive drought, she lines up golf balls for powerful men to drive into the carefully manicured verdant horizon. Between shifts, she wanders the immaculate grounds, sampling its luxuries and exploring its liminal spaces. The club’s members, including an industrialist and his expatriate niece, the president and his pampered wife, and a slew of Chinese tourists, engage in a complex dance with the doting and subservient staff. But something is rotting beneath the pristine fairways of the elite resort, as Isabel discovers when she tries to return a mislaid golf club to its patriarchal director, Dr. Palanca. The deeper she journeys into its most exclusive corners, the closer she gets to the violent truths of the club, her native Philippines, and her own past. Executive produced by Jia Zhangke, this Sundance award-winning debut announces writer-director Rafael Manuel as a major new voice in international cinema.

EA Sports FC 27 - Official Ultimate Team Deep Dive Trailer
Take a look at the FC 27 Ultimate Team trailer, the latest Deep Dive from EA Sports FC 27. Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Devora Wilde Revisits Her Greatest Video Game Performances
Ever wondered who played Lae'zel in Baldur's Gate 3, or who played Clea in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33? Turns out they're both Devora Wilde, who joins us to revisit all her greatest video game performances so far, including roles in games such as Cyperpunk 2007, Split Fiction, Cronos: The New Dawn, and so much more!

author: IGN YouTube
text:
EverRail - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
Check out the Early Access Launch Trailer for EverRail, an open-world base-building survival crafting game developed by Aesir Interactive. Players will take on enemies, scavenge for resources, and endure the brutal conditions of the Inara, a train that never stops. Upgrade the train and survive with friends in co-op in EverRail, available now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Forgotten Station - Official Announcement Trailer
Step into the world of Forgotten Station in this announcement trailer for this upcoming single-player, narrative, knowledge-based game in which you embody a lost traveler trapped in a time loop. To escape, you must navigate a mysterious train network, meet memorable characters with stories of their own, while gradually uncovering the rules of this strange world. Forgotten Station will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Moldrise - Official Launch Trailer
It started in your foot. Now it’s in your head. All that remains is the command: GO UP. Meet strange neighbors. Make bad trades. Every ascent teaches you what you should have done differently. Watch the unsettling Moldrise launch trailer for this psychological horror game. Moldrise is available now on Steam.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Dive or Die: Children of Rain - Official Launch Trailer
Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Dive or Die: Children of Rain, an underwater Lovecraftian horror roguelite developed by Drop Rate Studio. Players will head straight into the unknown depths from run to run to scavenge for supplies, attain upgrades, and make sense of the black rain in the process. Save the camp in Dive or Die: Children of Rain, available now for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer
Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator, an Indian street food vendor simulation game developed by Chameleon 42 Games. Players will take to the streets of India to serve the public and assemble intricate dishes, all in the name of saving their beloved. Chop up ingredients, cook up popular food, and excel in mini-games. Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Carnival Hunt - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
Carnival Hunt is out now in Early Access on PC. Watch the creepy Carnival Hunt early access launch trailer for this 5v1 first-person asymmetrical horror game. Five wind-up Bunnies must work together, manage their noisy keys, and find a way to escape an ever-changing carnival world while one player hunts them as the Carnival Monster.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Starsand Island - Official Release Date Trailer
Take a look at the release date trailer for Starsand Island, a life simulation RPG developed by Seed Sparkle Lab. Players will live out the calm country life in Starsand Island, explore the sights, create relationships, and engage in a variety of activities, such as home building, decorating, seasonal festivals, cooking, and more. Starsand Island is launching on August 18 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
